label: first copy step after <DEL> when the first original token is 2 or g, in long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely at recall_idx == 1: the step right after <DEL>, where the input is the echoed first original token and the model outputs original token 1. Within that step it needs the first token to be digit 2 (about 69% of mass) or letter g (about 30%). The output token barely matters. Magnitude grows with sequence length: it is near zero for L=6 (rate 0.1%), it starts at L=7, and it is strongest at L=8-9 (t=9-10 holds 87% of mass); top activations are all L=9 sequences starting with 2 or g. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, at later copy steps, or for other first tokens (o, q, t, 3 and others give only tiny scattered activations). Dev: P=0.86, R=0.92, F1=0.89, mass recall 0.98 for L>=7. Including L=6 lowers precision to 0.44.

issues: Most claims hold on dev and test. The feature is 100% copy-phase mass, essentially only at recall_idx==1 (15679 of 15683 activations), with in_tok 2 at 69% and g at 30% of mass. Output token barely matters. L=8-9 hold 86.6% of mass. The test scores reproduce: P=0.866, R=0.923, F1=0.894.

Systematic gap: the length threshold differs by token, so one shared L>=7 cutoff is wrong. For g at L=7 the predicate has precision 0.27 on test (mass recall 0.011). Those cases make up most of the 2212 test false positives (the misses output is dominated by 'g ... <DEL> *g*' at step 8, i.e. L=7). For 2 at L=7, precision is 0.96. g only becomes reliable from L=8 (P=0.93) and L=9 (P=0.999).

Misses on test are a minority pattern: digit 2 at L=6 with weak activations (about 0.03-0.25 of max), plus scattered small activations on other first tokens. These hold 1.3% of mass, which is acceptable.
The label's claim 'when the first original token is 2 or g, in long sequences' overclaims for g at L=7. The 'long' threshold is about 7 for 2 (weakly 6) and 8 for g.
skeptic.revised_label: first copy step after <DEL> (input = echoed first token) when the first original token is 2 (L>=7, weakly L=6) or g (L>=8); strength grows with length
